719-4247-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
719-4247-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.

2486-4694-5315-7306.notablePrerequisites:
You control your commander.
You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2486-4694-5315-7306.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Master Chef.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 1.

1379-1651-2034-5261-8117.description:
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting Raise the Alarm without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Raise the Alarm, creating two creature tokens that are also artifacts due to Encroaching Mycosynth.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping both creature tokens, untapping Isochron Scepter.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing one creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite tapped tokens, you may sacrifice any number of them to add infinite colorless mana.

1981-2403-2415-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding one mana of any color
When the creature dies, Moonlit Wake and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Moonlit Wake trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat.

338-3490-3910-5296-7810.easyPrerequisites: Light of Promise attached to Workhorse.
338-3490-3910-5296-7810.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional artifacts.
338-3490-3910-5296-7810.description:
Activate Breya by paying {2} and sacrificing two other artifacts, causing you to gain 5 life.
Light of Promise triggers, putting five +1/+1 counters on Workhorse
Animation Module triggers, holding priority, activate Workhorse three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token and a Food artifact token due to Tippy-Toe.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

1550-2105-5434.notablePrerequisites:
Sword of Hearth and Home attached to any creature you control except Combat Celebrant.
An opponent is unable to block Combat Celebrant or the creature with Sword of Hearth and Home attached.
You have not exerted Combat Celebrant this turn.
1550-2105-5434.description:
Declare the creature with Sword of Hearth and Home and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Sword of Hearth and Home attached.
Sword of Hearth and Home triggers, exiling Combat Celebrant, then causing you to search your library for a basic land card, then put the land and Combat Celebrant onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

3000-5670-6772.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
3000-5670-6772.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Syr Vondam triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token and a creature token.
Repeat.

1456-5078-7444.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

4798-5631-5686-7435.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
4798-5631-5686-7435.description:
Activate Hardened Academic by discarding Ovalchase Daredevil.
Activate Shilgengar's first ability by sacrificing another creature, creating a Blood token.
When the Blood enters the battlefield, Ovalchase Daredevil triggers, returning Ovalchase Daredevil from your graveyard to your hand.
Skeleton Crew triggers, creating a 2/2 Skeleton Pirate creature token.
Repeat.

2440-4785-7082-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
When Trusty Boomerang enters, Sokka and Suki's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When the Ally enters, Sokka's first ability and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Ally you control.
Resolve the Sokka trigger, attaching Trusty Boomerang to the Ally token.
Activate the Ally by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature and returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

240-2511-5223-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse
Aang, Swift Savior // Aang and La, Ocean's Fury

4668-6867-7043.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least two cards this turn.
4668-6867-7043.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}.
When Appa enters, it triggers, airbending Aang.
Cast Aang from exile by paying {0}.
Appa triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When Aang enters, it triggers, airbending Appa.
Cast Appa from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat from step 2.

465-4605-6798-7260.description:
Cast Nature's Rhythm by paying at most {3}{G}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Wormfang Drake and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Wormfang Drake trigger, exiling another creature if needed.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Wormfang Drake token enters, it triggers, exiling the nontoken Wormfang Drake.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the Wormfang Drake token
When the Wormfang Drake token dies, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
465-4605-6798-7260.notes: You can either cast Nature's Rhythm from your hand or for the harmonize cost, adjusting mana requirements accordingly.

2136-2676.description:
Activate Orthion's second ability by paying {6}{R}{R}{R} and tapping it, creating five token copies of Scourge of Valkas.
When the Scourge of Valkas tokens enter, each Scourge of Valkas triggers five times.
Resolve all Scourge of Valkas triggers, dealing at least 180 damage divided among a maximum of 30 targets.
2136-2676.notes: The 180 damage assumes you control no Dragons except Scourge of Valkas when starting the combo. For each additional Dragon you control, you'll deal a total of 30 more damage.

1479-2841-5671-6159.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Bloodstained Mire.
Your life total is at least 2.
1479-2841-5671-6159.description:
Fetch a land using Bloodstained Mire.
When the fetched land enters, The Necrobloom and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and The Necrobloom trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the The Necrobloom from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, The Necrobloom triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

647-1170-1329-3518.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by discarding your hand and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1786-2541-4017.description:
Activate Benthic Biomancer by paying {1}{U}, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Benthic Biomancer triggers, causing you to loot.
Queza triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Benthic Biomancer triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with six or more phyresis counters on it

3394-4487-5220.description:
Cast Phyrexian Marauder by paying {0}.
Phyrexian Marauder enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Mortuary and Weatherlight Compleated.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Phyrexian Marauder from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Weatherlight Compleated trigger, causing you to put a phyresis counter on it and draw a card, thus drawing Omarthis from your library.
Repeat.

560-608-2022-2034-5495.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
It is your turn.
560-608-2022-2034-5495.description:
Activate Thallid Soothsayer by paying {2} and sacrificing another creature, causing you to draw a card.
An opponent's Wedding Ring's second ability triggers, causing them to draw a card.
Xyris's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Snake and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Snake, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

3562-3817-6542-6798.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Sky Hussar, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Sky Hussar from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 5 life.
When Sky Hussar enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
Repeat.

2919-4186-5070.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2919-4186-5070.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Angelic Chorus triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

997-2060-3705-6701.description:
Cast Squee from your graveyard or from exile by paying its mana cost.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Squee.
When Squee is sacrificed, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
997-2060-3705-6701.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana value of the card in your graveyard.

465-2079-3742-4251-5929.notablePrerequisites: Leyline of Transformation on the battlefield with "Samurai" chosen.
465-2079-3742-4251-5929.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

643-1429-5330-5402.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
643-1429-5330-5402.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Repeat.

2533-2719-4050-4681.description:
Activate Loyal Retainers by sacrificing it, returning Sakashima of a Thousand Faces from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Karmic Guide.
When Sakashima of a Thousand Faces enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Loyal Retainers from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Sakashima of a Thousand Faces.
Repeat.

1849-2933-4499-5798.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Drowner of Hope.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate the Eldrazi Scions by tapping them, adding {2}.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite tapped Eldrazi Scion tokens, you may sacrifice them for infinite {C}, and then forego tapping or sacrificing subsequent Eldrazi Scions.

2092-4549-4669-5140.notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 3 or greater.
2092-4549-4669-5140.description:
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping Hajar, adding {B}.
Activate Hajar by sacrificing it, giving legendary creatures you control +1/+0 and indestructible until end of turn.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {B}, returning Hajar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1570-2351.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card during an opponent's turn.
1570-2351.description:
Draw a card during an opponent's turn.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
When the Tentacle enters the battlefield, Sage of the Falls triggers, causing you to loot.
Repeat from step 2.

1636-2857-3455.notablePrerequisites:
Adarkar Valkyrie does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one legendary creature.
1636-2857-3455.description:
Activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting any legendary creature you control.
Cast Vizier of Many Faces by paying {2}{U}{U}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of the legendary creature targeted in step 1.
Put the legendary creature into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Adarkar Valkyrie and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Holding priority, activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting Vizier of Many Faces.
Resolve the Adarkar Valkyrie trigger from step 4, returning the legendary creature to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Put Vizier of Many Faces into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Adarkar Valkyrie and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Holding priority, activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting the legendary creature.
Resolve the Adarkar Valkyrie trigger from step 9, returning Vizier of Many Faces to the battlefield from your graveyard as a copy of the legendary creature.
Repeat from step 3.

1689-4067-4343.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one card in hand.
You control a mana-producing permanent.
1689-4067-4343.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, tapping target creature an opponent controls.
Hylda of the Icy Crown triggers, causing you to pay {1} to draw three cards due to Eligeth.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping the mana-producing permanent.
Repeat.
You may also repeat this loop during each turn.

1749-2182-3858.description:
Activate Vampire Hexmage by sacrificing it, removing all counters from Dark Depths.
Dark Depths triggers, causing you to sacrifice it and create a 20/20 Marit Lage legendary creature token.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Mayael's Aria triggers, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control, gain 10 life and win the game.

1797-4050-4067-5003.notablePrerequisites:
At least two creatures have died this turn.
You control a mana-producing permanent.
1797-4050-4067-5003.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Inga, adding {1}.
When Inga dies, it's second ability and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Inga trigger, causing you to draw three cards.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping a mana-producing permanent.
Activate the mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Repeat steps 4 and 5 two additional times.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {4} to return Inga from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Inga enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to scry 3.
Repeat.

1912-4131-4832.notablePrerequisites:
Ensoul Artifact attached to Basalt Monolith.
Basalt Monolith does not have summoning sickness.
1912-4131-4832.description:
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

401-2034-4242.notablePrerequisites: You have seven or more cards in your graveyard.
401-2034-4242.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Su-Chi, adding {C}{C}.
Su-Chi dies, triggering itself and Decaying Soil.
Resolve the Su-Chi trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Decaying Soil trigger, causing you to pay {1} to return Su-Chi from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Su-Chi by paying {4}.
Repeat.

1339-1636-2627.description:
Activate Azami by tapping itself, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
The Insect enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

933-2103-2493.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Conjurer's Closet triggers, blinking Archaeomancer.
Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
